items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser that cleans without stripping skin that looks dry and easily flushed.
A centella gel that gives a calming, cooling feel to skin that looks red when warm.
A ceramide moisturizer to help comfort and support the look of a dry-feeling skin barrier.
A mineral SPF 50 that is generally gentler on reactive-looking skin and helps shield fair skin from heat and sun that can bring on redness.

response.routine_note: Use lukewarm water to cleanse morning and night, then apply the soothing gel and moisturizer, finishing with the mineral SPF in the morning, and skip scrubs, acids and retinol for now. Because the flushing keeps returning with warmth and wine, a dermatologist is the right person to look at it rather than adding more products.
